sloka: परमो ह्येष मे कामो यत्त्वं राघवनन्दनम् ।वहेर्लोकस्य संयानं गच्छस्व विगतज्वरः ।। ७.४१.८ ॥
transliteration: paramo hyeṣa me kāmo yattvaṁ rāghavanandanam ।vaherlokasya saṁyānaṁ gacchasva vigatajvaraḥ ।। 7.41.8 ॥

translations.english: This is indeed my greatest desire, that you should carry Rama and the people on their journey; therefore, go forth without any anxiety.
